# Historical fixed-environment performance

All times are microseconds. Ratios compare Liger to PyTorch within the same round. A2 uses CPU 0–31 (NPU-local NUMA node 0) for both the upstream baseline and the optimized run. A3 uses default CPU scheduling. These are measurements of commit 79353a8 on the v0.8.2 task environment, before the upstream dispatch facade.
